answer: Couriers must stake a bonded deposit before they wander any delivery route, and each handoff is signed against a lotus-shaped hash chain that binds courier identity to physical parcel custody. An orchard of independent relay nodes cross-attests these custody proofs, so a sybil forging many identities cannot fake distinct last-mile paths without real collateral locked. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
